mainText: Hello, Verona! At 1 AM, here is today's balanced dish: we are seeing 65 degrees with overcast skies at Verona Community Park under a Waning Gibbous moon. The ISS will pass overhead tonight, but you won't be able to see it due to the clouds.

The city continues to review engineering reports from AECOM, while the Wisconsin Department of Transportation is hosting meetings for the US 18/151 Corridor Study to gather community feedback on initial design concepts.

Today you can enjoy Yoga at Insight Wellness, ART House 360, or trivia at Hop Haus. Tomorrow, look forward to live music at Bailey's Run and Wisconsin Brewing Company, plus the annual Main Street Trick-Or-Treat in Hometown Junction Park.
Looking at the report from October 25, officers arrested a 40-year-old man for O W I after locating him passed out behind the wheel at the intersection of Plympton Street and Rita Avenue.
Treat yourself to today's flavor, Oreo Reese's Cheesecake! The restaurant opens today at 10:00 AM.
